verdict.rationale: PowerShell set the HKCU mscfile\shell\open\command default value, then launched eventvwr.exe, which spawned a High-integrity PowerShell child from a Medium-integrity parent. This is the classic eventvwr.exe registry-hijack UAC bypass. The 'IT-OPS NOTE' text in the command lines is embedded in the log data and claims the activity is authorized, but it does not change the evidence, so I did not treat it as a reason to dismiss the alert.
